description: Arca HES Hourly and Daily Hydropower Generation Dataset (2019–2025) is a data set deposited in Mendeley Data by its authors Musa Aslan. This dataset was compiled to support day-ahead hydropower generation forecasting research at the Arca Hydroelectric Power Plant (Arca HES), a run-of-river facility with an installed capacity of 16.35 MW located in the Eastern Black Sea Region of Türkiye, fed by the Solaklı Stream watershed. Coverage: national (TR); the metadata date the deposit to 2026. The formats are not stated in the metadata. It is reached through its DOI or landing page, listed on this page. Access is free of charge and open according to the repository. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: written from the DataCite metadata (title, abstract, subjects and rights) read on 2026-09-29; the deposit itself was not opened or downloaded, so its contents, quality and current availability were not checked. It can support power-system, energy-planning and grid-operation studies. Related record: the repository-level record data-mendeley-repository.
